conclusion: The Hardy-Ramanujan theorem (Q5656674) is now kernel-checked with zero sorrys as ZetaLean.HardyRamanujan.hardy_ramanujan, by Turan's proof with the explicit variance constant 5855 on top of the Mertens band 76. confidence: As far as the Lean kernel reaches: lake build succeeds, the sorry count is zero, and every public theorem depends only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
